question:
Let
\[
L=\lim_{n\to\infty}(n+100)^{\frac{5}{\log_e(n-50)}}.
\]
Then
solution: Taking logarithms gives $\ln L=5\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{\ln(n+100)}{\ln(n-50)}=5$, so $L=e^5$. Since $2<e<3$, we have $32<L<243$.
